description: The demo dataset for the transparency tables of the module (MOD1): organisations, the demo profile, access groups and their members, verifications, campaigns, donations and donor updates, as the demo store holds them before any call (amounts in major units, as the TS types); and for MOD2 the flow nodes, transactions, node visibility, trust score history, organisation chains with their activity log and the public embed config. Also the trust points per verification type.
